\section{Experiments}

MOT tracklet achieves a MOTA of 76.3 on this benchmark, as shown in
Table~\ref{tab:main}. Ours attains a MOTA of 81.6 with only 79 IDS errors,
confirming the gains in Table~\ref{tab:main} summarizes the benchmark comparison.

Each sequence contains at most 101 frames for tracking.
Ours runs at 79 FPS on the edge device.
The MOTA metric improved by 3 points across variants.

Table 2 shows the per-sequence ablation results in detail.
Table 3 reports the per-sequence ablation results.
Table~\ref{tab:assoc} lists the association cost components.
Figure~\ref{fig:overview} illustrates the architecture.
Figure~\ref{fig:missing-asset} is referenced nowhere else.
